issues.description: Return type annotation for simulate_msd_one_round is inconsistent between the problem statement, the template, and the solution. The problem statement specifies simulate_msd_one_round should return tuple[float, float] (error rate, acceptance rate). The template, however, annotates the function as returning list[float], while the reference solution implements and annotates it as returning tuple[float, float]. This mismatch can confuse students (especially those relying on type hints or reading docstrings) and lead to inconsistencies when they run or statically check their code.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the return type annotation in the template for simulate_msd_one_round to tuple[float, float] and ensure the docstring & any callers assume a (error_rate, acceptance_rate) tuple. This aligns the template with the problem statement and the reference solution and prevents confusion from mismatched type hints.
